embedding_root_cause: Sandboxed gbrain embed returned 'Forbidden' while identical curl/node fetches returned 200. Cause = OpenShell egress policy, not the gateway: gbrain is a compiled Bun binary; Bun fetch runs under the bun binary identity, which was not in model_ai_gateway.binaries. Fix: bind /usr/local/bin/bun (+/usr/local/bin/gbrain) to the endpoint. Also: provider env is injected at sandbox create, not per-exec -- post-hoc attach needs a restart (apply script attaches at create).
